title: Samsung Electronics to acquire Samsung Display's entire stake in TCL CSOT for $960 million
content: Samsung Electronics announced that it will acquire Samsung Display's entire stake in China-based TCL CSOT. Samsung Electronics will pay around $960 million for the 10.16% stake, and once the deal closes SDC will no longer hold any shares in the Chinese display maker. According to Samsung, the purpose of the acquisition is to strengthen its strategic cooperation with TCL CSOT.

content: Samsung Electronics announced its financial results for Q3 2026, with record revenues of $146 billion, up 14% from the previous quarter, and an operating profit of $80 billion. These results were mainly driven by Samsung's memory business, which set new records for revenue and profit thanks to strong demand for AI applications. title: Realtek targets 30% AI revenue share by 2030
content: Realtek Semiconductor quantified its AI business for the first time at an investor conference on October 29, setting a target for high-performance computing (HPC) and edge AI revenue—including automotive and robotics applications—to exceed 30% of total revenue by 2030. These businesses currently account for a high-single-digit percentage of revenue, as AI expands into infrastructure and edge devices.

title: Eutelsat eyes EUR10B revenue from IRIS2 as EU seeks homegrown answer to Starlink
content: Eutelsat said that it predicts at least EUR10 billion (US$11.2 billion) in revenue from 2032 to 2040 as it leads the EU's low Earth orbit (LEO) network initiative IRIS2. The European satellite player is viewed by the EU to be a homegrown alternative to SpaceX's Starlink satellite service and a key to reducing technological reliance on the US.

title: China's memory module bellwethers post record profits as 3Q26 momentum fades
content: China's listed memory module makers, whose results offer an early read on how the global memory upcycle is reaching the country's storage supply chain, reported net profit gains of more than 300-fold at the top end for the first nine months of 2026. Yet several of the largest players also posted sharp sequential profit declines in the third quarter, suggesting the windfall from low-cost inventory meeting surging contract prices is narrowing.

title: Samsung SDI posts 12-quarter high in 3Q26 operating profit
content: Samsung SDI, a major South Korean battery maker, posted strong results in the third quarter of 2026 as rising energy storage system (ESS) battery demand lifted operating profit to its highest level in 12 quarters. The company is also expanding into emerging applications, advancing the commercialization of all-solid-state batteries and securing new cylindrical battery customers in aerospace and humanoid robotics.
